name: OWASP scan + commons 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT bump (visibility, booking)
description: Update mercury.commons.version to 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT in visibility and booking module poms. Run OWASP dependency-check before and after via owasp-scan-v2.ps1, rename reports before/after, mvn clean package -DskipTests.

entries.summary: Bumped commons to 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT; recorded before OWASP results
After OWASP: booking HIGH 4->3 (jsoup fixed); visibility unchanged
Booking OWASP: databind fixed via jackson 2.21.6 bump; httpclient5 suppressed; wired --suppression into v2 script; t-digest flagged
entries.detail:
Findings for booking after-report: 4 HIGH/CRITICAL by severity field: databind CVE-2026-68497 (HIGH), httpclient5 CVE-2026-71290 (CRITICAL) + CVE-2026-40542 (HIGH), t-digest CVE-2026-87822 (HIGH).

Root cause databind: booking pom's own dependencyManagement imports jackson-bom at jackson.version=2.21.4, which wins over commons. Commons 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT uses jackson 2.21.6 but EXCLUDES jackson-databind from its jackson artifacts, so commons never drives databind. Fix: bumped booking jackson.version 2.21.4->2.21.6 (bom cached in .m2).

httpclient5: added CVE-2026-71290 + CVE-2026-40542 suppressions mirroring visibility (ION-16792, async/SCRAM paths not reachable; classic sync client used).

Tooling: owasp-scan-v2.ps1 (and v1 owasp-scan.ps1/.v1.ps1) never passed --suppression, so suppressions.xml only took effect in CI. Evidence: owasp-reports/s3-archiver (v2) has CVE-2026-71290 present vs owasp-reports/visibility/visibility-s3-archiver (CI) suppressed. Updated v2 to pass --suppression <module>/suppressions.xml when present.

t-digest CVE-2026-87822 (3.2): NaN centroid DoS, affects 3.1-3.3, no fix; left open for decision.

Doc written: booking/docs/2026-09-11-owasp-chk.md</detail>

entries.summary: Fresh booking scan: CRITICAL 1->0, HIGH 3->1 (only t-digest left). Commons parent jackson-bom governs commons repo only, not booking.
entries.detail:
Fresh owasp-scan-v2.ps1 -Group Booking -Module booking -Build (build OK 174s, suppression applied): booking CRITICAL 1->0, HIGH 3->1. databind CVE-2026-68497 gone (jackson 2.21.6); httpclient5 CVE-2026-71290/CVE-2026-40542 suppressed via new --suppression wiring. Only remaining HIGH: t-digest CVE-2026-87822 (3.2, no fix in 3.1-3.3), left open for decision. Promoted report to owasp-reports/booking/dependency-check-report-after.json.

commons parent finding: mercury-services-commons repo parent pom DOES import jackson-bom 2.21.6 in dependencyManagement, but it only governs the commons repo's own modules. It does NOT reach booking: dependencyManagement inherits via <parent> only, booking's parent is mercury-services:1.0 (monorepo root, which has no jackson-bom), and the published commons jar pom is flattened (no parent/depMgmt). Recommendation: add jackson-bom import (or a published mercury-bom) to the mercury-services root pom depMgmt and drop per-module jackson.version pins.

entries.summary: t-digest 3.2 is transitive via Elasticsearch 6.6.2 in booking; commons repo PARENT pom (published, unflattened) has jackson-bom 2.21.6 and can be imported as a BOM
entries.detail:
t-digest 3.2 provenance (mvn dependency:tree -pl booking -Dincludes=com.tdunning:t-digest):
com.inttra.mercury:booking:jar:1.0
  -> org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch:jar:6.6.2:compile
     -> com.tdunning:t-digest:jar:3.2:compile
So t-digest is transitive from Elasticsearch 6.6.2 (direct compile dep of booking), shaded into booking-1.0.jar. CVE-2026-87822 has no fixed release (3.1-3.3 affected) so a version override won't clear it; options are suppress-with-justification or ES upgrade.

Parent BOM confirmation: the mercury-services-commons REPO PARENT pom (com.inttra.mercury:mercury-services-commons:1.0, packaging pom) is published to .m2 and RETAINS <jackson.version>2.21.6</jackson.version> + jackson-bom import in dependencyManagement (it is NOT flattened; only the commons module jar pom is flattened via flatten-maven-plugin default/inherited mode which strips parent/depMgmt). So booking COULD import mercury-services-commons:1.0 as a BOM (type=pom, scope=import) to inherit databind 2.21.6 centrally. Depending on the commons JAR alone does not inherit it.

entries.summary: Visibility full scan (10 modules, commons 1.0.34): CRITICAL=0, HIGH=16. Remaining: databind 2.22.0 (needs 2.22.2) + t-digest 3.2. after-reports generated.
entries.detail:
owasp-scan-v2.ps1 -Group Visibility -Build -NoUpdate (commons 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT). Reactor BUILD SUCCESS 556s. All 10 deployable modules scanned with --suppression now applied. -after reports generated (dependency-check-report-after.json/.html) in each Out dir.

Totals: CRITICAL=0, HIGH=16 across 10 modules.
Per-module HIGH:
- 4 lambdas (s3-archiver, error-email, pending-start, outbound-poller): HIGH=1 each = CVE-2026-68497 jackson-databind 2.22.0.
- 6 shaded jars (inbound, itv-gps-processor, matcher, outbound, pending, wm-inbound-processor): HIGH=2 each = CVE-2026-68497 databind 2.22.0 + CVE-2026-87822 t-digest 3.2.

httpclient5 CVEs no longer appear (CRITICAL=0) -> confirms the new --suppression wiring works for visibility too.

Root cause databind in visibility: visibility/pom.xml pins <jackson.version>2.22.0</jackson.version>; CVE-2026-68497 fixed in 2.22.x line at 2.22.2. Fix = bump 2.22.0->2.22.2 (note: 2.22.2 not yet in local .m2, would need download). t-digest 3.2 transitive via elasticsearch (same as booking), no fix release.

Also extended owasp-scan-v2.ps1 Visibility group from 4 to all 10 deployable modules.

entries.summary: Reconciled doc §6 vs artifacts: commons 2.21.6 does not propagate to consumers; removing booking's pin would NOT inherit 2.21.6 (falls to mediation/2.21.4). Per-app bump is required.
entries.detail:
Reconciled user's question against mercury-services-commons/docs/2026-09-09-sdk-commons-cve-change-analysis.md §6. The doc's "databind resolves to 2.21.6 in the flattened commons POM" describes resolution WITHIN commons' own build (jackson-bom imported ahead of dropwizard-dependencies). It does NOT propagate to consumers: verified the flattened commons-1.0.34-SNAPSHOT.pom in .m2 has jackson-databind only as <exclusion>s (no databind dep, no dependencyManagement; flatten uses default mode per commons/pom.xml:485 "Do NOT use flattenDependencyMode=all"). The doc's own §6 caveat confirms: commons 2.21.6 is "necessary but not sufficient — each app must still bump its own Jackson property (visibility needs 2.22.2)".

Answer to "if booking pin removed, does it inherit 2.21.6?": NO. booking dependencyManagement imports only jackson-bom (booking/pom.xml:53-63); removing it drops single-version enforcement and databind falls to nearest-wins mediation (dropwizard 2.21.4 / shaded local-es 2.17.2 / etc.), not 2.21.6. Central inheritance only possible by importing a BOM that manages databind (e.g. mercury-services-commons:1.0 parent pom, published unflattened with jackson-bom 2.21.6, as type=pom scope=import) or adding it to the mercury-services root pom. So the applied booking bump to 2.21.6 is the correct "app must bump its own" step.

entries.summary: Removed booking jackson-bom pin: databind now inherits 2.21.6 from commons, OWASP clean (only t-digest). BUT Jackson stack fragmented (yaml/smile 2.8.11, cbor 2.12.6) via ES 6.6.2 — recommend restoring the bom import.
entries.detail:
User updated commons 1.0.34-SNAPSHOT (reinstalled 02:18) to declare jackson-databind 2.21.6 as a DIRECT dependency (verified in flattened .m2 pom). Then removed booking's jackson-bom dependencyManagement import (kept ${jackson.version}=2.21.6 property, still used by jackson-module-jsonSchema and jackson-dataformat-xml). Rebuilt + rescanned.

RESULT: build OK 176s. databind resolves to 2.21.6 inherited from commons. OWASP CRITICAL=0 HIGH=1 (only t-digest CVE-2026-87822). Report promoted to dependency-check-report-after.json.

REGRESSION FOUND: removing the jackson-bom import fragmented the Jackson stack (bom previously aligned the whole family). Now shaded: databind/core 2.21.6, but dataformat-yaml 2.8.11, dataformat-smile 2.8.11, dataformat-cbor 2.12.6, annotations 2.21, datatype-guava/jakarta-rs/several modules 2.21.4. Old ones come transitively from Elasticsearch 6.6.2. This is exactly what the removed comment warned about. Mixing databind 2.21.6 with dataformat-yaml/smile 2.8.11 is a runtime-compat risk; tests were skipped.

RECOMMENDATION: restore jackson-bom import at 2.21.6 — clears databind CVE AND realigns whole stack. Awaiting user decision.

entries.summary: Final: restored jackson-bom import at 2.21.6 — booking OWASP CRITICAL=0 HIGH=1 (t-digest only) with full Jackson stack aligned to 2.21.6. Pin-removal fragmentation avoided.
entries.detail:
Restored booking's jackson-bom import at 2.21.6 (reverting the pin removal) after the pin-removal test showed Jackson stack fragmentation. Rebuilt + rescanned: build OK 97s, OWASP CRITICAL=0 HIGH=1 (t-digest only), and ALL com.fasterxml.jackson* artifacts now aligned to 2.21.6 (dataformat-yaml/smile/cbor back to 2.21.6; annotations 2.21 minor-line normal). Report promoted to dependency-check-report-after.json. Doc updated (booking/docs/2026-09-11-owasp-chk.md §5a + §6).

Rationale: the jackson-bom import aligns the whole Jackson family, not just databind. Removing it cleared the databind CVE (via commons' new direct 2.21.6) but let ES 6.6.2's old transitive jackson (2.8.11/2.12.6) leak in — a runtime-compat risk. Keeping the import gives both: databind 2.21.6 + aligned stack. commons' direct databind remains a safety net for consumers that drop their pin.
